newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street set to open flat to slightly down.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street set to open flat to slightly down.

text.p: Wall Street shares were set to open flat to modestly lower on Thursday, watching bond yields for interest rate concerns, analysts said.
"We could see some pressure early on," Charles Payne, an analyst at Wall Street Strategies said. He said the stock market was starting to worry about future rate increases.
Blue chip defensive stocks could also struggle, spooked after Nike Corp said its quarterly earnings would be below forecast, another analyst said.
The long bond was up 5/32 at a 7.02 percent yield, while Standard & Poor's futures index was up 0.20 points at 850.75.
